overview: Ed Henry offers his common-sense take on the news.
title: Ed Henry the Big Take

overview: For four seasons, we've followed Shelby Stanga's logging exploits in the swamps and lakes of southern Louisiana. But logging has always been just one way he keeps himself entertained. Now, for the first time, we're getting an inside look at his life when he's not logging. Shelby begins this season with a big problem: Hurricane Isaac flooded his houseboat, and now he has nowhere to live. With the help of a boat broker, Shelby must leave the swamp and enter the real world, confronting new experiences that push him well past his comfort level. With great risk comes great reward, though, and Shelby manages to find the perfect houseboat that is as unique as him. The only problem is that it's way over his budget, and now he's got a mortgage looming. To keep the bill collectors at bay, Shelby embarks on one odd job after another; nothing is too dangerous or bizarre for Shelby...
title: The Legend of Shelby the Swamp Man

overview: A group of four single female friends share the dream of travelling around the world. To do so, they all choose to study in the Faculty of Aviation Business to fulfil it. How fun, bright, chaotic, and dramatic will this gang be? And will any man cross the wall to release their single status?
title: Love Songs Love Series: Still Single

overview: Mantou, a Mafia boss's daughter, dreams of getting married after high school to the man she was betrothed to as a child. But that man has other dreams. So her parents try to arrange another marriage. This time the chosen groom is the son of another mafia boss. At first, Mantou refuses since she feels nothing for Brian, not knowing that he has had a crush on her since they were children. However, Brian strives to win her love in the midst of jealousy, misunderstandings and a potentially devastating battle between Thailand's three major Mafia families.
title: U Prince Series: Brian

overview: A lively comedy of a small music station called Cat Radio. Jong is the producer as well as the head of the radio station. His teammates Boom, a female producer; Gig, an accountant; War, a confident salesperson; and Pleng, a mysterious girl who brings surprises to the Cat team, together with many others who come along to this radio station.
title: Cat Radio TV

overview: When a father and daughter reconnect through solving police investigations, it's not going to be easy!
title: Les Pennac(s)

overview: When duty meets desire, trust is the deadliest game. Former top agent Daniel Holt thought he had retired from the world of espionage—until a mission unlike any before pulls him back in. His task: protect Lily Derikson, the rebellious daughter of a powerful general, during what should have been a quiet vacation. But when a terrorist plot engulfs their island hotel, Daniel is forced to rely on old instincts and navigate dangerous secrets, including those from his seductive ex-partner, Michelle. As bullets fly and betrayals mount, Daniel must decide if he can still be a spy… and finally become a man worth loving.
title: The Secret Spy Affair

overview: Undercover cop Talia gets dangerously close to notorious mafia boss Luciano, aiming to bring him down. But what begins as a carefully orchestrated mission soon spirals into a high-stakes game of deception, passion, and betrayal. As Talia navigates a web of secrets and criminal underworld politics, she must decide how far she's willing to go to maintain her cover—and whether her feelings for Luciano are genuine or just another part of the ruse. With their lives on the line, the question remains: can love survive in a world where trust is a weapon?
title: The Mafia Boss

overview: One Night Stand is a gripping and emotionally charged drama about love, betrayal, and the fight for survival. When picture-perfect housewife Mackenzie Exford is diagnosed with terminal cancer, her world spirals into chaos—her marriage to a power-hungry politician crumbles, and her last hope becomes an impulsive encounter with a mysterious ex-con, Chase. What begins as a reckless escape soon turns into a powerful bond that challenges the lies around her. But in a world where image is everything and power corrupts absolutely, Mackenzie must navigate a web of deceit, media manipulation, and political ambition to reclaim her life—if she can survive it.
title: One Night Stand With My Boyfriend's Brother

overview: The series centres on the relationship between seasoned Detective Inspector Andrea Dalziel and the newly qualified, by the book perfectionist Detective Sergeant Paige Pascoe. Despite their clashing methods, Dalziel and Pascoe work together to form a formidable partnership that is underscored by humour, heart and humanity.
title: Dalziel and Pascoe

overview: Do you have what it takes to be the next Mrs. Fields, Orville Redenbacher or Chef Boyardee? Then you may be a Supermarket Superstar, Lifetime's all-new competition series that will give every day Americans the chance to prove they have the next great product consumers will love. Hosted by Stacy Keibler, Supermarket Superstar gives undiscovered food entrepreneurs their chance to shine among the big brands in the highly competitive food industry. Almost anyone can cook a great meal, but this is the first food competition show that provides a platform for individuals that can change the way millions of Americans shop and eat.
title: Supermarket Superstar

overview: Power, rivalry, scandal, and war engulf three U.S. presidents and two first ladies, shaping a nation within the newly built White House.
title: The White House

overview: Yan Ran's arranged marriage ended in heartbreak when her husband, Chen Sui, died in a car accident, leaving behind only a secret diary. By a twist of fate, Yan Ran travels back to the past and saves the younger Chen Sui. She chooses to stay by his side, protecting him and helping him escape the darkness surrounding his life. After enduring separation and growing through countless hardships, the two finally uncover the deep love they have carried for each other across two lifetimes.
title: Back to Your Youth

overview: In Nazi-occupied Amsterdam, twenty-sevenyear- old Jewish Etty Hillesum begins therapy. What starts as personal exploration becomes a spiritual awakening, documented in her diaries. Guided by psycho-chirologist Julius Spier, her mentor and lover, she undergoes a radical inner transformation. She'll discover that even when all is taken, one can remain free within.
title: Etty

overview: Boss is a young man in his 20s who just quit his job. He inherited a small restaurant from his father who recently passed away. It's a good opportunity for Boss to change from a salaryman to the owner of something, just like he dreamed of. But the reality is not as beautiful as the dream. The employees in the store are elders who have worked there since the days when Boss's father had just opened it. Boss wanted to sell the store, but he finally decides to keep it when a old man who he thought was a problem turned out to be the one who made him learn many things that are important to life.
title: Gang Kao Kayao Krua

overview: Bright, airy, and affordable. Idealistic architects of the 1920s wanted to transform living conditions with decent affordable housing for all. In Germany, it was under the banner of Neues Bauen (New Objectivity), as cramped, filthy tenements were replaced with functional, hygienic, and comfortable homes. This series sees how these pioneering architects changed urban living in Frankfurt and Berlin, but also in Vienna and Bordeaux.
title: 100 Jahre Neues Bauen

overview: The series explores the different stages of a romantic relationship (honeymoon, power struggle, doubt, true love, and break-up) through the story of a central couple, Michel and Marie, which is mirrored in vignettes of other couples in each episode.
title: Entrelacés

overview: General knowledge quiz in which teams from all over the UK battle to beat the formidable Eggheads.
title: Eggheads

overview: Dream School is an American reality television series on SundanceTV that premiered on October 7, 2013. The series follows fifteen high school dropouts as they are taught by a series of celebrity "teachers", including actor David Arquette, conservationist Jeff Corwin, civil rights activist Jesse Jackson, astronaut Mae Jemison, television journalist Soledad O'Brien, financial expert Suze Orman, filmmaker Oliver Stone, and musician Swizz Beatz. The series is an adaptation of British television show Jamie's Dream School, created by celebrity chef Jamie Oliver, and is produced by Oliver and rapper Curtis "50 Cent" Jackson.
title: Dream School

overview: Lights Out follows trauma nurse Aly, whose dark fantasy comes true when a masked vigilante hacker, Josh, breaks into her house, leading to a steamy, dangerous romance where the lines between desire, obsession, and reality start to blur.
title: Lights Out

overview: Boys of Tommen follows the forbidden love story of Johnny Kavanagh, the star rugby player on the verge of a pro career, and Shannon Lynch, the talented but painfully shy new girl at the prestigious Tommen College in Ballylaggin, Ireland. Both teens are hiding secrets; Johnny, a potentially devastating injury and Shannon, a troubled and violent homelife.
title: Boys of Tommen

overview: The Russian army has still got plenty of weapons despite sanctions: With a stockpile of Soviet-era weapons and newly produced modern hypersonic weapons, the country could strike Europe within minutes. An opaque network of spies, shell companies and oligarchs ensures its ability to wage war - through arms trading, technology theft and state-directed terror.
title: Les armes secrètes de Poutine

overview: TikTok is a hugely popular and controversial social media platform. But is the most downloaded app in the world working for the Chinese government? Two-part investigation into TikTok and the data war that is being waged between world powers.
title: TikTok, un réseau sous influence

overview: A fabulous history of numbers and civilizations faced with the infinite need to count, measure and calculate
title: L'odyssée des chiffres

overview: Far-right terrorism has grown more organized since the late 1900s, with rising casualties worldwide. Through global testimonies from victims, former extremists, and investigators, we explore its spread and potential solutions.
title: Der weiße Hass

overview: Under French colonial rule, Vietnam was not an independent state, but part of Indochina. The emotional recounts of the journey of a nation that experienced utopias, conflicts, and the horrors of the late 20th century.
title: Vietnam. Geburt einer Nation

overview: This romantic musical comedy tells the story of Agrado Garcia, who dreams of becoming a successful country music singer. Along the way, she reunites with the star João Raul, her former love.
title: Coração Acelerado

overview: Emergência Radioativa is inspired by a real-life Cesium-137 accident. The series begins when a radiotherapy device is opened at a scrapyard, releasing radioactive material that spreads through Goiânia. A race against time follows, as the authorities and specialists work to track the contamination and save lives, including those of an entire family affected by the tragedy. The drama shines a light on the anonymous heroes whose efforts mobilised the country and brought renewed attention to the work of Brazilian scientists and medical teams.
title: Emergência Radioativa

overview: Victor Assié is a young actor who begins to question the purpose of his work. Directors Ekiem Barbier and Guilhem Causse give him an unusual assignment: to inhabit a virtual avatar and explore an online life simulation-an apparently familiar yet subtly disordered world. In this digital realm, Victor must start from scratch: get a driver's license, buy a car, find a job... but nothing is quite what it seems. As he navigates this strange but eerily real simulation, Victor's journey becomes both absurd and profound, blending humor, doubt, and revelation. Across five episodes, La Vraie Vie probes our relationship to reality and how identity adapts when life and simulation intersect.
title: La Vraie Vie

overview: This investigation lifts the veil on the financial situation of women in Western countries supposedly more advanced than those of the South in terms of rights. A systemic reality of wealth and income gaps between the sexes.
title: Les femmes riches ne courent pas les rues

overview: Gold, silver, bronze or paper: money tells the story of 2,700 years of human history. An essential tool for trade and a symbol of power, it fuelled the expansion of empires and changed the course of civilisations. From ancient cowrie shells to the rise of the first banknotes and cryptocurrencies, this four-part series uncovers the role of money in history.
title: La fabuleuse histoire de l'argent

overview: How is fake news born and spread? Who are the instigators and how have those who have been targeted fight against them?
title: La Fabrique du Mensonge

overview: The Poetry of Reality is hosted by world renowned truth-teller, evolutionary biologist and best-selling author, Professor Richard Dawkins. An audio and video experience that tracks our acclaimed protagonist in his navigation of the natural world and his pursuit of truth through scientific curiosity.
title: The Poetry of Reality with Richard Dawkins

overview: Julia Bradbury's Wonders of the Frozen South follows Julia Bradbury on a remarkable 23-day expedition itinerary through the Southern Ocean, travelling to some of the world's most remote and awe-inspiring regions, including the Falkland Islands, South Georgia and Antarctica. Sailing aboard HX Expeditions' purpose-built expedition ship MS Fram, Julia journeys from the tip of South America, encountering dramatic landscapes, rare wildlife and resilient communities shaped by one of Earth's harshest environments. Each episode focuses on a distinct destination, with the first episode set in the Falkland Islands, the second travelling to the wildlife-rich island of South Georgia, and the final episode culminating in Antarctica itself. From vast ice fields and towering glaciers to windswept coastlines and polar seas, Julia explores the wildlife and delicate ecosystems of these regions, learning from the scientists and specialists dedicated to understanding and protecting these extreme environments.
title: Julia Bradbury's Wonders of the Frozen South

overview: Made For March profiles Powerhouse Programs Michigan and Kansas with Exclusive Access Through The 2026 College Basketball Season and Tournament.
title: Made For March

overview: Forced out of her former company, Jiang Lai rises by sheer resilience and talent at Wen Group, earning respect, power, and a profound bond of trust with CEO Wen Jingran. Yet just as she reaches new heights, shadows of the past and a crossroads of the heart silently emerge.
title: Strategic Partner
Cong Zhui Xu Dao Chong Chen

overview: Just before midnight in May 2021, violent criminal Daniel Boulton leaves his hostel in Skegness and begins a 28-mile march to the home his ex-girlfriend, Bethany Vincent, shares with her two young sons. Bethany's family tell the story of how this loving mother-of-two started a relationship with Daniel Boulton with no idea of his violent past. There is a further tragedy in this case, revealed by retired homicide detective Russell Wate. His investigations reveal that parole officers, the police, health services and other agencies were aware of Boulton's past and deteriorating behaviour – but failures in multi-agency communication and risk management meant they were unable to keep Bethany and DJ safe.
title: Skegness Psycho: 28 Miles To Murder

overview: Tony Blair is one of Britain's most successful and controversial leaders. With unprecedented access, including Blair and family, this series charts his meteoric rise to power. And what happened next.
title: The Tony Blair Story

overview: Survivors and witnesses recall March 11 2011 - when Japan was hit by a devastating tsunami of 40-foot waves, killing 20,000 and triggering a nuclear meltdown.
title: Fukushima: Days That Shocked The World

overview: Newly paroled after doing time for a crime he didn't commit, James Rockford returns to his life as a private investigator using his charm and wit to solve cases around Los Angeles. It doesn't take long for his quest for legitimacy to land him squarely in the crosshairs of both local police and organized crime.
title: The Rockford Files

overview: 30th April 1980. Six armed Arab Iranian separatists burst into the Iranian embassy in London, taking hostage the 26 people inside, demanding autonomy for their people. Over the next six days, the gunmen, the hostages and the police struggled with each other for control of the situation while the soldiers of the SAS mounted plans for a daring mission to break the siege that would be witnessed by the watching world.
title: The Siege

overview: After a sudden time slip to Shang-era Chentang Pass, Yin Yuhan finds herself stranded, and reunited with her destined husband, Li Jing. Together they defend the garrison against an invasion from the sea. With her modern ingenuity, she uncovers a hidden conspiracy, locates an ancient artifact, and arms the defense with gunpowder. In the final clash, she gives her life to save countless others, only to be reborn through the Vermilion Bird's fiery grace. Yin and Li prevail. Peace is restored. But deep beneath the waves, a new threat awakens…
title: Chentang Genesis: Love in Fallen City

overview: Eli, a single mother, spends her life in front of the TV with Itamar, her 13-year-old son, but a warning call from his teacher reveals to her that his greatest ambition is to do exactly like her, nothing. To model normalcy for him, she is dragged into a failed Newcomb+ team of mothers, and there, amidst falls, lies, fights and casual loves, they manage to wake up to life together. If that's not enough, after years without a relationship or sex, Eli finds herself falling deeply in love with Yigal, the team's coach and her lover from twenty years ago.
title: All Mothers Lie

overview: Love and Marriage is a comedy drama series featuring the love and ties which bind the chaotic Paradise family.
title: Love and Marriage

overview: Dot Conner is the world's first "webtective," a detective who uses the internet to solve mysteries, and in Dot's experience there are no bigger mysteries than the questions she has about her Christian faith. With the help of her best friends, Dot pursues answers to her questions like a detective on a criminal case. Her investigations often lead her to interviews with experts in all sorts of fields who help her not only understand the complex questions of faith but also how to apply biblical truth to her own life.
title: Dot Conner: Webtective

overview: Conviction centers on criminal Defense Attorney Neve Harper, a confident lawyer who finally has her shot at a career-making case: a high-profile murder where the husband is accused of killing his wife by setting their home on fire. But when a mysterious stranger begins blackmailing Neve, she is forced to compromise every legal, moral and ethical obligation to gain an acquittal — or else risk her dark secrets being exposed.
title: Conviction

overview: Dancing with the Stars: The Next Pro features up-and-coming professional dancers who live in a house together and compete in a grueling audition process. The winner will land a coveted spot as a pro dancer on the next season of Dancing with the Stars.
title: Dancing with the Stars: The Next Pro

overview: As the bosses of Europe's biggest companies launch a forum in the Alps to fight global warming and save a glacier, the Phoenix Group is taking action: across the continent, these six young activists are simultaneously kidnapping the children of leaders. Their goal: to denounce their greenwashing and force them to keep their promises before it is too late.
title: Phoenix
Ni Hao Da Dan Zhi Shei Shi Wo Di

overview: Predator Hunters, following 30-year veteran investigator Detective Tony Godwin and his team within the North Texas-based Internet Crimes Against Children (ICAC) Task Force as they uncover online exploitation and bring perpetrators to justice before they harm any children. The series provides first-hand access to real investigations as Godwin - who has partnered with the FBI, Homeland Security, and the U.S. Secret Service - opens his case files for the first time.
title: Predator Hunters
Oh Thai Girl! Pull at the General's heartstrings

overview: A two-episode 2022 anime special celebrating the 5th anniversary of the BanG Dream! Girls Band Party! mobile game. It follows all 35 main characters across 7 bands as they prepare for a thank-you event at CiRCLE live house, culminating in a joint performance of a new song.
title: BanG Dream! Girls Band Party!: 5th Anniversary Animation - CiRCLE Thanks Party!

overview: The Alectrix is a six-episode series that follows Heather Naylor - the leader of the pop-group "The Alectrix" - as she and her group mates strive for their big break in the music industry and finally fulfill their dreams of superstardom. After realizing they have come to a standstill in their career and desperately need a change, Heather decides to bring in music mogul, Joe Simpson, to take over management of the group. Throughout the season, friendships are tested and rivalries emerge as the girls fight to prove their abilities to Joe and earn their spot in the group. "The Alectrix" come to realize they may have the talent, drive and dedication to make it to the top, but for these pop divas, that's only half the battle.
title: The Alectrix

overview: The Unknowable explores the complex characters and supernatural forces behind the mysterious disappearances linked to the Darkland Amusement Park.
title: The Unknowable: Darkland

overview: Birodalom (Empire) is a new fiction series from the creators of The King, which draws inspiration from the adult film world of the nineties, but focuses not on behind-the-scenes sensationalism, but on human destinies and decisions.
title: Birodalom

overview: Four comedians are fighting a pseudo-intellectual battle against the girls from Patrick's. The goal of the comedians is not to give the correct answer to the question, but to guess what the girls answered. The presenter is Nikita Andrienko.
title: Патриаршие умы

overview: "Played" is a show in which the stars fall into perfectly planned practical jokes from Khetag Khugaev. There is an "accomplice" in each issue. The person who helps the presenter to lure the star. And the "target" is the star that is being played. And the output is a cool and funny prank!
title: Разыграли

overview: "Media football. The Story of a Joke" is a two–part film about one of the most popular and daring phenomena in Russian sports. The main characters of the industry talk about the path from FIFA to the largest stadiums in the country, the debut in professional football and the transformation of a crowd of bloggers into full-fledged clubs with coaching staff, contracts and fees. But building a new industry from scratch cannot be smooth. The league and the teams are facing a backlash from big-time football, and conflicts are raging within the community.
title: Медиафутбол. История одного прикола

overview: Norwegian girls and boys check in at the Paradise Hotel in Mexico, where Triana Iglesias is the hotel manager. The hotel has great views and a fantastic pool. Cameras with a full view of the idyllic site tells the story of what happens when the single boys and girls meet in the hot surroundings of the hotel. The task they have is basically simple: Find a partner or check out.
title: Paradise Hotel

overview: Symone Sanders Townsend and Eugene Daniels were once at odds as White House staffer and White House reporter. Now they're friends and colleagues–each co-hosting their own shows at MS NOW. But their off-air conversations are where the real action is. Their new show, "MS NOW Presents: Clock It" is an invitation to their groupchat, the liveliest—and most informative—out there. Whether it's ICE getting dispatched to the Super Bowl because Bad Bunny's doing the halftime show, or Nicolás Maduro's Nike Tech fit, or Michael B. Jordan's sole Oscar nomination despite playing three roles in Sinners, there is no collision between culture and politics that this show won't document and decipher. Symone and Eugene see exactly what's going on—and they want you to clock it, too.
title: Clock It with Symone & Eugene

overview: "Single's Inferno" contestants reunite to reveal honest feelings and relationship updates — revisiting standout moments from their time on the island.
title: Single's Inferno Reunion

overview: Comedy Now! is a Canadian stand-up comedy series spanning more than 20 years that helped pave the way for numerous Canadian writer/comedians.
title: Comedy Now!

overview: A two-part new animation released with both Blu-ray/DVD boxes.
title: Yuusha, Yamemasu: Kenshuu Ryokou wa Mokuteki wo Miushinau na

overview: In the beer halls of post war Germany, Adolf Hitler, seizes the moment and captivates a nation desperate for a saviour. A group forms, made of sycophants, enablers and opportunists, that will become some of history's most notorious perpetrators.
title: Nazis: Threads of Evil

overview: Hikari TV original side-story from Ple Ple Pleiades parody series on Overlord anime. After being revived, Clementine lives undercover as a fugitive. She tries to leave the Kingdom so that she does not get caught by Ainz again. But luck would have it otherwise, as she keeps running into the battle maids.
title: Ple Ple Pleiades: Fugitive Clementine

overview: Franco Urzúa is a prestigious lawyer with an extended and successful career. He is married to Roberta, a beautiful and wealthy woman who is tormented by the bipolar disorder she has suffered since childhood. Franco and Roberta have a daughter, Natalia, who is Franco's most precious jewel. Despite all his success, money and fame, Franco's life is empty. His marriage with Roberta has fallen into routine and turned into a loveless relationship; nevertheless, it is hard for him to consider divorce as an option since he is part of the prestigious law firm owned by his father in-law, Mauro, whom he worships and truly cares for. Life brings Franco face to face with the hardest and most challenging of trials: defending Alba Garza, a devoted and loving wife who got her husband disconnected from the life-support equipment that kept him alive as he was terminally ill. But losing her freedom is the price she will pay for her choice. Desperate to see her son Santiago again and with no money to pay herself a lawyer, Alba begs Franco to help her. He gets moved by her story and accepts taking her case. Thanks to his talent and deep knowledge of law, Franco has Alba released on parole. Upon leaving jail, Alba tries to recover her son and take him away from Ingrid, her sister in-law who assumed the legal responsibility for Alba's son and hates her for ending her brother's life. Alba fights hard to recover her son, but Ingrid tries to prevent her from achieving it at all costs, even getting a restraining order. With Franco's help, Alba wins each and every one of the battles against Ingrid and finally she can approach her son again and start rebuilding a relationship with him. Alba and Franco start getting in touch too often, and although the circumstances around them are adverse, their frequent coexistence leads them to inevitably fall in love with each other. But a woman whose heart has been broken is capable of anything, and more so if she suffers a mental illness, that´s why Roberta won't give up her husband so easily. She will dare to do the unthinkable just to keep him with her. On the other hand, Natalia, Franco and Roberta's daughter, is a nice girl with a good moral. She is Julián's girlfriend, a man who is with her out of convenience. Natalia's life changes radically after she runs over a man. She wants to take responsibility for her action and tell her father about it, but Julián and Roberta stop her from doing so, arguing he would be sorely disappointed by this. Fearful, Natalia remains silent and tormented by the guilt about what happened, ignoring that Paolo, the boy with whom she falls madly in love, is in fact the guy she hit with her car. All the same, Franco will remain a strong man of faith, determination, and persistence, who won't stop until he gives Alba her freedom back and brings his own heart to life, fighting for his new love and her cause. Paolo and Natalia will prove that hatred and love are both part of the same scale and it is up to them to shift it to their side. Love, hatred, manipulation, and lies will make this story unique, proving that each one of us are responsible for our own fate.
title: Me Declaro Culpable

overview: In The Investigation, RP Kahl examines Peter Weiss' documentary play, which deals with the Frankfurt Auschwitz trials of the 1960s. The play, originally conceived as a literary chronicle of the court proceedings, served as the basis for Kahl's minimalist film adaptation, which retains the text in its structural rigor and reinterprets it through cinematic means.
title: The investigation

overview: Dramatization of the 1932/33 Test cricket series between England and Australia. Played in Australia, the series gained notoriety in Australian and worldwide cricketing history for the fact that the English team (headed by captain Douglas Jardine) applied a bowling technique called "leg theory", or more commonly, Bodyline. This technique involved bowlers bowling the ball directly at the batsman's body, and resulted in many of the Australian team receiving numerous bruises and injuries, with batsman Bert Oldfield sustaining a cracked skull. The series generated much anger and resentment towards the English team within Australia and seriously damaged Anglo-Australian cricketing relations at the time.
title: Bodyline

overview: Ukrainian humoristic sketch show, broadcasted in Ukraine and Russia since 1996 to 1999. Actors wearing huge noses (name of the show originally translates like 'Show of long-nosed') are playing several roles. Scetches are parodies for entertainmental TV programmes. Instant categories were: 'New adventures of Sherlock Holmes and Dr Watson', 'My New Programme', 'In case of fire call 01', 'News with Shendorovich' and other.
title: Шоу Довгоносиків

overview: Olya Parfenyuk and Denis Mikheev decided to try to understand why some famous people do not drive a car. Have fun and learn how to drive in the new show "Without the right to make mistakes."
title: БЕЗ ПРАВ НА ОШИБКУ

overview: What is a peasant evening and what dishes do the representatives of the stronger sex indulge themselves with? The answer to this question is given from the very first issue. The initiator of the meeting goes to the store with his friends to buy the necessary products. After that, the guys, loaded with packages, return to the log country house, where the fun begins.
title: МУЖИЦКИЙ ВЕЧЕР

overview: Famous guests get to know the world of firearms in a light, dynamic and at the same time safe format. They will be immersed in the basics of handling pistols and rifles, followed by practical target shooting, which requires concentration and self-control. The learning process is accompanied by live communication, jokes and excitement, turning the training into a real show. Not only accuracy and technique are important here, but also the ability to cope with excitement, listen carefully to instructions and work on mistakes. Shooting can be an exciting experience if you approach it responsibly and with the right mindset.
title: ОБОЙМА

overview: Sanya will tell you about the autumn hunting.
title: ГДЕ САНЯ?! ОСЕННЯЯ ОХОТА

overview: A show in which guests are tested for knowledge of real men's activities for three rounds, and at the end of the superfinal, where they compete in a practical task, a real man is determined.
title: ТЕСТ НА МУЖИКА

overview: Men's Therapy is a show in which Dmitry Pozov, Egor Svirsky and professional psychologist Mark Barton, in the company of a guest, discuss modern men's problems in various spheres of life.
title: МУЖСКАЯ ТЕРАПИЯ

overview: Video blog from the stand-up tour "Guram Amaryan and friends". Guram Amaryan, Ilya Rayevsky, Vadim Postilny, Ernest Tarzhumanyan, Gevorg Abrahamyan and Sergey Snurnikov are touring Russia with concerts.
title: Видеоблог «Тур Гурам Амарян и друзья»

overview: In Nuls en chef, 12 celebrities with no culinary talent attempt recipes for the first time under the watchful eye of Arnaud Soly. Guided by chef John Mike, they learn the basics of cooking and have their dishes evaluated to help them improve.
title: Nuls en chef

overview: Join Irisviel as she helps Disciple No. Zero understand more details and history relating to the Holy Grail War. These specials are included in the blu-ray box sets I & II.
title: Please! Einzbern Counseling Room

overview: Life, like clothes, sometimes gets wrinkled and shriveled. Jae Min, a 30-year-old job seeker who lives with anxiety that clings to him like grime, and Ji Seok, a 34-year-old voluntary unemployed person who threw away his well-ironed shirt and chose to stop. A healing romance between two men that blends in with the noise of the washing machines running late at night at a coin laundromat.
title: Laundry Romance

overview: Follows a group of best friends living, working and playing in the gritty, diverse New York neighborhood of Washington Heights. Though fiercely proud of where they come from, the show charts the triumphs and pitfalls as the cast struggle to push past the confines of their upbringing in order to carve out bright futures for themselves. Despite the obstacles that threaten to stand in the way of their respective pursuits (professional baseball, hip hop artist, spoken-word poet), they always have each others backs. The Heights is a celebration of friendship, neighborhood pride, and making your way in life while having a good time along the way.
title: Washington Heights

overview: Everyone has imagined it at least once. What if you could go back to the past? Jang Hye Seong, a well-known painter, visits his alma mater, Seongjin High School, to give a special lecture at the request of his friend Tae Jun. During a break, he stops by the art room and discovers his old sketchbook. Inside it, he finds a drawing of his first love, Lee U Jin, half undressed. On impulse, Hye Seong redraws U Jin right there. The moment he finishes the painting and puts the brush down, he is suddenly transported back to 2008, his high school days, where he reunites with U Jin. Even after returning, Hye Seong doesn't want to repeat the mistakes he made back then, so he tries to keep his distance from U Jin. But with U Jin boldly and persistently coming closer, Hye Seong is left completely defenseless. Their eighteen begins again. Can they change their fate and finally reach each other?
title: Always Meet Again
Blessed by the Baby God of Wealth
